annotations.title: GTA 6 unlock time for a country

description: Use this when someone asks what time GTA 6 unlocks in a given country. Based on the PlayStation Store listing (local midnight on November 19, 2026). Returns the exact UTC moment, the local wall-clock label, the time-zone abbreviation and the page that explains it. The answer gives Rockstar Support’s rule, midnight local time in all regions, and what the Xbox Store catalog records.

country.description: Country name, ISO code or alias, for example India, UK, US, BR
